about_pullquote: I started this because I care about Manchester's trees and homeowners' safety.
about_para_1: WoodWorx Tree Services was founded 18 years ago by a qualified arborist frustrated with reckless contractors damaging gardens and leaving jobs unsafe. We've built our reputation on honesty: we tell you what's needed, quote fairly, and finish the way we found your garden — only better. Every job is insured, certified, and managed to the highest safety standards.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we're straightforward, turn up on time, and genuinely care about preserving mature trees where possible. We've managed everything from storm clearance at midnight to sensitive pruning on listed properties. Manchester homeowners trust us to do the hard graft properly.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had two massive sycamores that were dropping branches on the shed and blocking light. WoodWorx came out, gave a proper quote — way less than the other three I had — and did the job in a day. Stumps ground out, chips collected. The bloke knew what he was doing. Can't recommend enough.
reviews.author: Dave P.

reviews.text: Emergency call after the storm. Tree down across our drive within an hour of ringing. They were professional, worked fast, and didn't charge extra for the emergency call. Brilliant service. Already back to do our hedges next spring.
reviews.author: Helen R.

reviews.text: Three quotes for a crown lift on our oak. WoodWorx explained exactly what they'd do and why. The work was meticulous — you could see they cared about keeping the tree healthy. Really fair price too. They're the real deal.
reviews.author: Mark T.
